binary_weights: Both layers use only +/-1 signs times per-output positive digital gains; differential GH/GL pair per sign.
hidden_activation: Digital clipped ReLU [0,1], rounded to8 bits; straight-through derivative for rounding during training. Inputs are unchanged5-bit pixels0..16.
selection: Four QAT configurations, each up to400 epochs. Choose checkpoint by inner-validation correct count, then cross entropy, then earlier epoch. Refit on all1347 training samples for the selected epoch count. Original450 test images are evaluated only after freezing.
continuous_initializer: 200 epochs, Adam lr0.003, same architecture and8-bit activations, fit on inner training only during selection.
hardware_scope: Same four COMSOL histories and five short snapshots; same seeds0..99 assignment policy extended to both layer shapes. Frozen-state inference only; ideal periphery/interconnect.
